name: Spinal Epidural Lipomatosis
definition: Pathological excess of unencapsulated epidural fat causing spinal canal narrowing and potential radiculopathy or myelopathy, associated with obesity, exogenous steroids and endocrine conditions.

investigations.principle: MRI is the diagnostic study of choice and demonstrates epidural fat compression.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor, occult injury or condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Address steroid exposure/obesity/endocrine contributors where possible
amber: Severe neural compression may require surgical decompression.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Medo/Vata-related phenotype may be described only in parallel with modern anatomical diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Pathological excess of unencapsulated epidural fat causing spinal canal narrowing and potential radiculopathy or myelopathy, associated with obesity, exogenous steroids and endocrine conditions.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
